headline.title: Beating Beta — 9 Jun 2026
headline.summary: Guru pair: Ray Dalio (defensive, All-Weather) vs. Michael Burry (bearish on AI momentum). CPI trigger day. Chip rebound +7%.

stories.title: Ray Dalio & Michael Burry: Defensive vs. Contrarian
stories.toc_summary: Dalio warns of AI bubble; Burry holds PLTR/NVDA shorts. Consensus: market running on narrow base.
stories.quick_take:
Ray Dalio (Bridgewater) — DEFENSIVE: AI valuation bubble risk + rising yields (4.57%) confirm All-Weather thesis. Bullish: Gold, non-US equities, bonds. Bearish: US Tech megacaps.

Michael Burry (Scion) — BEARISH on AI momentum: Holds PLTR $912M puts + NVDA $186M puts. Chip rebound (MU +10%) tests his thesis — holding so far. Bullish: EL, LULU, REGN.

Synthesis: Both agree market runs on too narrow a base. PLTR-position critical — two gurus bearish with real capital. CPI (Jun 10) is the next directional test.

bullets.label: Ray Dalio
bullets.text: All-Weather Portfolio — Gold, EM, Bonds. Bearish on concentrated US Tech. Gold at $4,330 = hedge working.

bullets.label: Michael Burry
bullets.text: Short PLTR ($912M puts) + NVDA ($186M puts). Contrarian long: EL, LULU, REGN — neglected quality compounders.

bullets.label: Consensus
bullets.text: Market on narrow foundation. Gold exposure justified even without full bear conviction. Watch CPI Jun 10.

callout.label: KEY WATCH
callout.text: CPI May 2026 — Jun 10, 8:30 ET (consensus +3.8% YoY). Hot number = bond selloff, Burry thesis strengthens.

Gold $4,330, WTI $89, EUR/USD 1.07, Bitcoin $61,279 +1.2%. Stagflation risk in market pricing: high yields + elevated VIX. Chip rebound (MU +10%, SOXX +7%) likely short-squeeze, not fundamental shift.
